title: SWF export: gradient fills + CXFORM color effects; gradient transform in model
description: Two model features publish as nothing: (1) Gradient fills — encodeShape only handles fill.type solid (shapes.ts:341-352); linear/radial gradients (Color panel, 0019) export as NO fill. Implement GRADIENT/FOCALGRADIENT fill styles. Blocker: the model stores only angle/focalPoint (engine/types.ts:53-68) — SWF requires a gradient matrix, and the Gradient Transform tool needs one too; add a gradient transform matrix to the fill model (FLA serialize + renderer consume it). (2) Color effects — no CXFORMWITHALPHA writer exists anywhere in packages/swf; BitmapDisplayObject.alpha and future instance color effects are dropped. Also LineStyle2 flags are hardcoded 0 — carry SolidStroke caps/joints/miterLimit (shapes.ts:396). See docs/05, docs/15.
